title: Fix Natural Aim PvP Tracking
objective: Make Natural Aim Assist remain meaningfully active through real PvP click gaps and high-motion tracking without turning into a hard camera lock.
acceptance_criteria: Require Attack uses a combat-intent window rather than exact-frame button-down gating.
Committed target and controller state survive normal gaps between PvP clicks.
High camera speed no longer crushes assistance during an established target track.
Initial target acquisition becomes useful quickly without snapping.
Regression simulations cover realistic PvP click cadence and combat-intent expiry.
Minecraft 26.2 Java 25 build and runtime smoke test pass.
